description.value:
Trigger a hit would reduce you to 0 HP

Emergency Vent 1/day

Mod slots cap at "as many small ones as you can scrounge," plating resistance extends to 10 against all physical damage types simultaneously, and once per day, when a hit would reduce you to 0 HP, you can instead vent the suit into full Slippage and drop to 1 HP.

That is evidence of a genuine, standing content gap in real pf2e itself, not license to SKIP. [REDLINE-NO-SCHEMA] for the "full Slippage" cost, independently.
